You always know what comes next. The Tasks page shows the whole workflow, from the patch to the printed show.
On top is the next thing to do, with a button that takes you there. The line shows the seven steps, done in green.
Below, every DB has a square for every step. Orange is still to do, yellow needs attention, green is done.
Click Do this now. Setup opens on the right step, for the right DB.
Setup explains each step in a few lines, shows what is done, and lets you skip a step. Nothing is locked.
The progress bar at the bottom left shows how complete the show is. Click it for the checklist, with a jump to the place where it is solved.
And on the Overview page, a short bar shows the next step too, so you never have to search.
